lines.text: Until now, there were only two answers. Right... or wrong.
Kickoff changes the question. Call the exact score. Stake on it. And if you land close... you still get paid.
The nearer you land, the bigger your share of the pool.
Send your AI one line... and it plays every matchweek for you.
Climb the board. Chase the season's pool.
Kickoff. Beat the pack. Keep the stack.
